item.tib: snyan rgyud zhi gcod mkha' 'gro'i bdag dbang gsal byed
item.coloph: de ltar snyan rgyud zhi gcod dbang gi gsal byed lags (lag) khrid 'di/ mkha' 'gro ma yis lung gi snyan du brgyud/ gong ma'i (mas) gsungs bzhin yi ger bkod/ nyes 'gal srid na bla ma yi dam dang / mkha' 'gro mkhyen ldan rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge bas don gnyis sangs rgyas myur thob shog snod med rigs la mi spel zhing / snod dang ldan pa'i gang zag la/ btang bzhug (bzhag) bka' rgya zin par bya/ mkha' 'gro'i bsnyan ('gros snyan) rgyud dbang gi rjes byang zhes bya ba mar ston lha yi blo gros kyi (kyis) sbyar ba dge'o//
